name: Agram Match
summary: 6-hand trick game where only trick 6 of each 6-card hand scores 1 point; most hand wins after 6 hands wins.

player.meaning: hidden 6 cards dealt this hand, shrinking to 0

game.meaning: undealt remainder never viewed and takes no part
current hand dealer, random hand 1 then clockwise
cards played face-up this trick in seat order
winner of last trick and leader of next trick

setup: Build the 35-card deck: hearts diamonds clubs A-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3 plus spades 10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3 with no kings queens jacks deuces and no ace of spades.
Set every player's match_points to 0 and hand to empty and discard_pile and stub to empty.
Set hand_number to 1 and choose dealer_seat at random for hand 1.
Hands stay hidden and no discussion messages are used.

round.effect: reset deck to 35 cards, clear hand stub discard_pile trick_cards, deal 6 cards to each hand from deck in two batches of 3 clockwise from left of dealer_seat, remainder to stub, set trick_number to 1 and trick_winner to left of dealer_seat
send each player their own hand
announce hand_number dealer_seat and trick leader

answer.restricted_to: legal cards only: leader any card in hand, follower holding led suit only cards of lead_suit, follower void any card

round.effect: play one card from hand to trick_cards, set lead_suit from first card, remove card from hand

rank trick_cards by rank of lead_suit only, highest wins, off-suit cannot win, set trick_winner, move trick_cards to discard_pile, clear trick_cards and lead_suit, increment trick_number unless it was 6
repeat play-card and resolve-trick steps until trick_number equals 6 completed tricks
add hand_win_points 1 to match_points of trick_winner of trick 6, others add 0
rotate dealer_seat clockwise by 1 and increment hand_number by 1 and reset trick_number to 1 for next hand
continue if hand_number <= num_hands 6, else end match

ending.decided_by: seat with highest match_points wins; if two or more tie for most then draw

rules.text: When the deck is built, then it has 35 cards: hearts diamonds clubs A-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3 and spades 10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3 with no kings queens jacks, no deuces, and no ace of spades.
When a card is ranked, then hearts diamonds clubs rank A above 10 above 9 above 8 above 7 above 6 above 5 above 4 above 3, and spades rank 10 above 9 above 8 above 7 above 6 above 5 above 4 above 3.
When a trick is won, then suits are not ranked and only the led suit matters.
When the match is played, then it has 6 hands.
When hand 1 starts, then dealer_seat is chosen at random, and when each later hand starts, then dealer_seat rotates clockwise by 1.
When a hand is dealt, then each player receives 6 cards in two batches of 3 clockwise from left of dealer, and remaining cards form a face-down stub that is never viewed and takes no part.
When a hand is played, then it has 6 tricks and hands shrink from 6 to 0 as cards are removed after each trick.
When trick 1 starts, then the player left of dealer leads any card face up.
When a follower holds any card of the led suit, then they must play a card of the led suit, and when they hold none, then they may play any card.
When a trick is decided, then the highest rank of the led suit wins and an off-suit card cannot win.
When a trick ends, then the trick winner leads any card to the next trick.
When tricks 1-5 end, then they score nothing except determining who leads next.
When trick 6 ends, then its winner wins the hand outright and scores 1 final point and all other players score 0 for the hand.
When a card is played, then it is shown to all players, and when a hand is held, then it is otherwise hidden and no discussion messages are used.
When a player chooses a card, then only legal cards are offered so not following when able is not allowed.
When 6 hands are complete, then the player with the most final points wins, and when two or more tie for most, then the result is a draw among all players.

offers.question: play a card
offers.who: each player in turn in clockwise order from trick leader
offers.options: leader: any card in hand; follower holding led suit: only cards of lead_suit in hand; follower void in led suit: any card in hand; off-suit and illegal follow options are never offered

choices.what: 3 to 5? no: 3 to 4 players with suggested 4
choices.why: source says 3 to 4 and designer fixes suggested 4; minimum 3 because with 2 there is no multi-way trick race or void signalling and trick-6 timing is trivial; maximum 4 because a larger table makes one trick-6 win too diluted and turns too long to read discards

choices.what: thoughtful play at 4: save a high card of a suit others are void in for trick 6, read follow/void signals, lead suits to exhaust rivals
choices.why: only trick 6 scores so trick 1-5 are about gaining lead and gathering information while preserving a trick-6 winner

choices.what: no talk poll; card plays only
choices.why: source bans discussion so hands stay hidden; simultaneous poll talk would add noise and leak hands, so only sequential play asks are used

choices.what: card codes like AH 10S and arithmetic rank values for trick compare
choices.why: engine has no card type so text codes plus arithmetic on led-suit ranks decide trick_winner, never model opinion

choices.what: all numbers fixed as filed; no open payoff to choose
choices.why: source gives every count so parameters copy them directly

simplifications.what: shuffle and two rounds of 3 via random draws with remove from deck and append to hand, remainder to stub
simplifications.why: engine has no physical shuffle; shared_deck_draw workaround uses list operations

simplifications.what: trick winner computed by arithmetic rank compare on trick_cards of lead_suit in an update step
simplifications.why: engine decides outcomes by arithmetic, not by opinion

simplifications.what: trick loop and hand loop via repeat plus check on trick_number and hand_number with dealer rotation update
simplifications.why: step list is flat so counted repetition replaces manual redeal flow

simplifications.what: stub enforced by none visibility and never referenced after deal; discard_pile holds removed cards
simplifications.why: engine needs stated state for dealt and removed cards
